title: OSAC install preflight report
description: Result of the OSAC install preflight. Published as the ConfigMap key render.json (the last render that passed), as the OSAC-PREFLIGHT-JSON v1 line on stderr (a failed render), and in the hooks[] of `helm install --dry-run=server -o json`. apiVersion is v1alpha1: fields may change until the first external tool binds to it; every change is listed in the changelog below.
$comment: Changelog. v1alpha1: initial version. Reports never contain Secret data: Secret names and keys only, and URLs reduced to scheme, host, port and database. In the stderr line the colons of generatedAt are written as the JSON escape \u003a; parsers decode it to the same string.

phase.description: When the checks ran. Later phases (install progress, post-install) reuse this schema.

tier.description: render: evaluated while Helm renders the chart. runtime: evaluated by an in-cluster hook.

mode.description: The preflight.mode that was in effect.

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 time in UTC when the report was produced.

helmVersion.description: Version of the Helm client that rendered the chart.

kubeVersion.description: Kubernetes version of the cluster, or null when the render had no cluster access.

revision.description: Helm revision being rendered. Compare with the deployed revision to tell whether the report is current.

action.description: upgrade when a deployed revision of this release already exists, else install.

blocking.description: Number of results that stop the install in this mode.

id.description: Stable check identifier; the key of preflight.skip.

severity.description: required checks block when they fail; warning checks only warn (they block in strict mode).

requiredFor.description: Services that need this check. core is always needed.

status.description: pass; fail (a required check failed); warn (a warning check failed); unknown (could not be determined, including offline); skipped (not applicable or skipped on purpose, see skipReason).

remediation.description: What to do about a failure. Shown for every status; relevant when status is fail, warn or unknown.

observed.description: What was found. Names and keys only, never Secret data.

skipReason.description: Why the check did not run; empty unless status is skipped.

blocking.description: Whether this result stops the install in the mode that was in effect.

dependsOn.description: Present when the result is unknown because these checks did not pass; it is not counted as a second root cause.
